observations: Deng et al., Annals of Thoracic Surgery (2015), compared healthy human adult and pediatric AVIC responses to LPS/TLR4 stimulation.

entities.name: Greater adult AVIC TLR4 response
observations: In cultured healthy human AVICs, LPS/TLR4 stimulation induced higher inflammatory and osteogenic marker levels in adult than pediatric cells despite comparable TLR4 protein; lower STAT3 phosphorylation partly explained the difference.
